recent_specialist_changes.message: worker-c: Deterministic handling of same-clock conflicting same-record revisions

evidence.default_collectors: Nine _collect_live collectors (runner.py:37-46), each with previously verified deterministic run_once coverage; no new independent test execution.
evidence.optional_activation: runner.py:82-108 gates both optional collectors behind network=True; Kote additionally needs kote_enabled=True; Glassnode requires glassnode_config and environment API key. Optional failures become FAILED attempts and source_errors; Kote can preserve rows from PARTIAL collection.
evidence.archive_to_scoring: runner.py:120-123 appends all collected observations, reloads up to 100000 records, then excludes provenance.context_only from scoring_history before CapitalFlowEngineV11.build(as_of_ms=now). This establishes wiring but not a tested end-to-end PIT outcome.
evidence.archive_to_handoff_health: runner.py:136-137 passes full history to handoff and evidence_health; evidence_health.py:69-80 applies point_in_time_filter and computes separate scoring subset; evidence_health.py:95-115 exposes visible/scoring counts and scoring_missing. These separate measurements are better proof than archive_records_loaded/scoring_records_loaded, which are not PIT counts.
evidence.glassnode_atomicity: providers_v1.py:292-309 collects multiple configured metrics into a local list and returns only after all succeed; runner.py:100-108 catches failure and appends no rows for that attempt. This is observable fail-closed all-or-nothing behavior, not evidence of a production defect.
evidence.test_scope: test_kote_activation.py tests collector parsing and activation without runner.run_once; test_v1_handoff.py checks Glassnode metadata/parser and handoff without enabled runner.run_once; test_evidence_health.py:76-83 uses run_once(network=False). No complete opt-in run_once -> archive -> handoff -> evidence_health -> PIT regression was found in inspected tests.
evidence.proposed_deterministic_regression: Future test-only candidate after executor reliability mitigation: monkeypatch _collect_live to return empty, stub optional collectors and credentials, run_once(network=True, opt-in flags, fixed as_of_ms, tmp archive); assert optional attempt status and appended archive rows, handoff family/source evidence, evidence_health visible vs scoring counts at before/after available_at_ms, context_only scoring_missing, and failed-collector preservation without false success. Assert frame scoring outcome rather than equating archive counts to PIT eligibility.
evidence.production_completeness: No reproducible production integration failure demonstrated at exact SHA; the optional full-chain test gap is unverified coverage, not an independently promotion-blocking production defect.

decision.overall_promotion: BLOCKED until C repair, independent validation and Supervisor consensus
